title: 第3章 五行煞尸元神法九极元环孵化第4章 金玉坊市出售购买被盯上
content_zh:
“五行煞尸元神法，以五行灵体为载体，分裂神识之种种入，以修士神魂为养料壮大取而代之，可吸五行煞气，化为活尸...，可同时操控对敌，也可在冲击境界之时，吸收煞尸分身的修为，辅助冲击......”
顾景元倒吸一口冷气。
按照这玉简所说，这五行煞尸元神法可操控五具煞尸分身，以此来壮大神魂，同时还能操控对敌，以及吸收冲击境界。
这简直可怕。
“不愧是核心区域的东西，这秘术也太强大了。”
说着，顾景元又看向青铜铁片：“都是核心区域的，应该也不会差吧。”
神识探入，但没有丝毫动静。
顾景元皱眉，想了想随即注入灵力。
慢慢的，青铜铁片上的复杂纹路亮起。
很快，又是一股信息灌入顾景元脑海之中。
信息也不少，但不如五行煞尸元神法庞大，一时间顾景元头脑昏沉，但随着时间流逝，慢慢还是消化了。
“九极元环，以金木水火土阴阳风雷九种极致材料炼制，每一枚元环都有不同作用，多枚元环可产生不同的特殊领域，可压制法宝，破除阵法......”
“哈哈哈哈，好，好啊，这完全可以作为我的本命法宝。只不过这里面的材料，以我现在的实力基本上没可能凑齐，最起码也得筑基之后了。五行煞尸元神法也得炼气后期才能分裂神识之种，而且对宿主要求也高，但里面记载的几种秘术和神魂修炼之法倒是可以修炼.....”
顾景元喃喃。
但这些都只能作为辅助，最重要的还是本身的修为。
想到这，顾景元也是盘膝闭目，运转金灵锻元功。
金灵锻元功，是一门颇为精妙的金属性功法，它并非追求极致的杀伐之力，而是讲究“以金锻体，以灵养元”，通过在体内凝练一道精纯的金灵之气来反复锤炼灵力与肉身，旨在打下无比坚实的根基。
功法运转时，引天地间的金属性灵气入体，化作一道细微却极为锋锐的金灵之气，引导其在周身经脉中按特定路线运行。这个过程如同用一把无形的锉刀打磨经脉，初时会有针刺般的痛楚，但经脉会随之拓宽、强韧，灵力的精纯度也会显著提升。
只要能忍受这个痛苦，修炼速度就不会慢，而且虽不追求极致的杀伐之力，可锻造的金元灵力其攻伐之威也不弱。
好在原身修炼这么长时间，已经习惯了，他接替之后也能忍受。

吸纳，吞吐，不断修炼。
泉眼之中偶尔冒出的丝丝缕缕灵气，也会被顾景元牵引一部分炼化，剩下的则是留给周围药田。
同时，每隔十天服用一颗聚灵丹。
一瓶聚灵丹，五颗，不到两个月便全部炼化。
随后顾景元便只能完全依靠天地间游离的灵气，以及泉眼中偶尔冒出的灵气修炼。
期间也看护灵药，浇灌，松土，同时修炼法术。
金灵锻元功炼气初期的时候，带了两个下品法术，分别是金灵壁，金刺术。
炼气中期也带了两个中品法术，分别是金元盾，金剑术。
其中金剑术他已经修炼入门了，如今重点是防御法术金元盾。
洞中修炼第三个月的的时候，八个红玉蜂卵，孵化了七个，其中一个没有孵化成功。
红玉蜂，拇指大小，通体晶莹，散发淡红光晕，翅膀薄如蝉翼，呈半透明状，上面有类似玉的脉络纹理。
顾景元拿出红玉蜂浆给红玉蜂卵喂食，只要渡过前面这几天，这些红玉蜂便可自己出去寻找食物了。
继续修炼，转眼间又过去三个月时间。
顾景元一直在山洞之中修炼功法和法术，未曾离开半步。
他知道，仙宫出世，定然会引来很多人，坊市那边不会太平。
content_en:
"The Five Elements Evil Corpse Soul Technique uses the Five Elements Spiritual Body as a carrier to split the spiritual consciousness and replace it with the soul of a monk as nourishment. It can absorb the Five Elements Evil Spirit and turn it into a living corpse... It can control the enemy at the same time. It can also absorb the cultivation of the Evil Corpse clone to assist in the impact..."
Gu Jingyuan took a breath of air.
According to what this jade slip said, the Five Elements Evil Corpse Primordial Spirit Method can control five Evil Corpse clones to strengthen the soul, and at the same time, it can control the enemy and absorb the impact of the realm.
This is simply terrible.
"As expected of something from the core area, this secret technique is too powerful."
As he said that, Gu Jingyuan looked at the bronze and iron pieces again: "They are all from the core area, so they should be fine."
His spiritual consciousness penetrated, but there was no movement at all.
Gu Jingyuan frowned, thought for a while and then injected spiritual power.
Slowly, the complex lines on the bronze iron piece light up.
Soon, another stream of information poured into Gu Jingyuan's mind.
There was a lot of information, but it was not as huge as the Five Elements Evil Corpse Yuan Shen Technique. Gu Jingyuan was confused for a while, but as time passed, he slowly digested it.
"Nine-pole rings are made from the nine ultimate materials of gold, wood, water, fire, earth, yin, yang, wind and thunder. Each ring has a different function. Multiple rings can produce different special fields, which can suppress magic weapons and break formations..."
"Hahahaha, okay, okay, this can definitely be used as my natal magic weapon. It's just that with my current strength, it's basically impossible to assemble the materials. At the very least, I have to build the foundation. The Five Elements Evil Corpse Soul Method also requires the late stage of Qi refining to split the seeds of divine consciousness, and it also has high requirements on the host, but several secret techniques and soul cultivation methods recorded in it can be practiced..."
Gu Jingyuan murmured.
But these can only be used as assistants, the most important thing is your own cultivation.
Thinking of this, Gu Jingyuan also crossed his legs and closed his eyes, performing the Golden Spirit Forging Yuan Gong.
The Golden Spirit Forging Yuan Gong is a rather exquisite metal-based technique. It does not pursue the ultimate killing power, but emphasizes "forging the body with gold and nourishing the spirit with spirit." It repeatedly tempers spiritual power and physical body by condensing a pure golden spirit energy in the body, aiming to lay an extremely solid foundation.
When the technique is running, the metallic spiritual energy from heaven and earth is introduced into the body and transformed into a subtle but extremely sharp golden spiritual energy, guiding it to run along a specific route in the meridians throughout the body. This process is like polishing the meridians with an invisible file. There will be acupuncture-like pain at first, but the meridians will be broadened and strengthened, and the purity of the spiritual power will be significantly improved.
As long as you can endure this pain, your cultivation speed will not be slowed down, and although you do not pursue the ultimate killing power, the offensive power of the forged Jinyuan Spiritual Power is not weak.
Fortunately, the original person has been practicing for so long and has become accustomed to it, so he can tolerate it after he takes over.
Absorb, swallow, and practice continuously.
The strands of spiritual energy that occasionally emerge from the spring will be drawn and refined by Gu Jingyuan, while the rest will be left in the surrounding medicinal fields.
At the same time, take one Spirit-Gathering Pill every ten days.
A bottle of Spirit Gathering Pills, five of them, were all refined in less than two months.
After that, Gu Jingyuan could only rely entirely on the spiritual energy floating between heaven and earth, as well as the spiritual energy that occasionally emerged from the springs to practice.
During this period, he also took care of the elixirs, watered them, loosened the soil, and practiced magic.
In the early stages of practicing Jinling Yuan Gong, I brought two low-level spells, namely the Golden Spirit Wall and the Golden Thorn Technique.
In the middle stage of Qi refining, two middle-level spells are also brought, namely the Golden Yuan Shield and the Golden Sword Technique.
Among them, he has already mastered the golden sword technique, and now the focus is on the defensive spell Jinyuan Shield.
During the third month of cultivation in the cave, seven of the eight ruby ​​bee eggs hatched, but one of them failed to hatch successfully.
The red jade bee is about the size of a thumb, with a crystal-clear body and a light red halo. Its wings are as thin as cicada wings and translucent, with jade-like veins on them.
Gu Jingyuan took out the ruby ​​honey jelly and gave it toAfter feeding the ruby ​​bee eggs, as long as the first few days pass, these ruby ​​bees can go out to find food on their own.
Continue to practice, and three months have passed in the blink of an eye.
Gu Jingyuan has been practicing exercises and spells in the cave and has never left.
He knew that the birth of Immortal Palace would definitely attract a lot of people, and there would be no peace in Fangshi.
